rules: Never reuse a situation/threat/twist. Any 7 videos: >=3 formats, no format >3 times, no same format twice in a row.

episodes.situation: a menacing cucumber creeps toward Nugget; the viewer's hand blocks it twice
episodes.twist: Nugget sniffs it, bites it: it was a pickle; heart eyes, '10/10 would eat again'

episodes.situation: 3AM: the clock flips to 3:00 and Nugget goes full zoomies, knocks a mug off the nightstand while staring at the camera
episodes.twist: owner turns the lamp on: Nugget is instantly 'asleep' in loaf pose; lights off, clock 3:01, ROUND 2
